## AI Draft Replies for Every Gmail Email

Open your inbox to find a sensible draft reply already written under every email - you just edit and send. Cuts email time roughly in half.

**Setup time:** 15 minutes  ·  **Level:** Intermediate

**You'll need accounts/credentials for:** Gmail, OpenAI

**Setup steps:**
1. Connect your Gmail account in both Gmail nodes.
2. Edit the system prompt in the AI node: your name, sign-off, tone, and any standing rules (pricing answers, links you always share).
3. Optionally narrow the trigger filter, e.g. exclude newsletters with '-category:promotions'.
4. Activate, then email yourself from another address and check your drafts folder.

Free templates and updates: navkhan103.github.io

### How it runs

Starts from **New Email**.

1. A Gmail Trigger polls for new emails in your inbox.
2. An AI node reads the sender, subject, and body, and writes a reply following your style instructions.
3. A Gmail node saves the reply as a draft on the same thread - it never sends anything.
4. You open the thread, tweak the draft if needed, and hit send.

### If something breaks

The read and AI nodes here **retry 3× automatically** (5s apart), which absorbs rate limits and brief timeouts.

Nodes that **send or write deliberately do not retry** — a send that reached the far end but lost its response would otherwise fire twice, so you'd get duplicate messages or duplicate rows.

To be told when one of those fails, build a workflow starting with an **Error Trigger** node that posts to Slack or email, then set it under **three-dot menu > Settings > Error Workflow**. Do it once and point every workflow at it.

values.content: You draft email replies for me. My name is YOUR NAME. Tone: friendly, direct, no fluff. Sign off with 'Best,\nYOUR NAME'. If the email asks something you cannot know, draft a polite holding reply. Output only the reply body, no subject line.
